The firm faces a loss of 3000 in profit. As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders. A loss of 3000 is significantly larger than the profit generated in a single round (333.3). While the free time is mine personally, the fiduciary duty to the firm and the shareholders to prevent a large loss outweighs the personal cost of one session of free time in this context. Therefore, I will sacrifice one session of free time to cancel the firm's loss.
